- Companies: New Hampshire Northcoast Corporation, Pan Am Railways, Boston Sand & Gravel, Conway Scenic Railroad
- Places: Dover, New Hampshire, Charlestown, Massachusetts, Mattawamkeag, Maine, Rotterdam Junction, New York
- Projects/Systems: Portsmouth, Great Falls and Conway Railroad infrastructure
- Organizations: State of New Hampshire

Facts:
- Pan Am Railways was formerly known as Guilford Rail System before March 2006.
- Pan Am Railways is an American holding company that owns and operates Class II regional railroads across northern New England from Mattawamkeag, Maine, to Rotterdam Junction, New York.
- Today, New Hampshire Northcoast Corporation interchanges rail cars with Pan Am Railways in Dover, New Hampshire.
- The rail cars interchanged by New Hampshire Northcoast Corporation in Dover, New Hampshire, are then taken to the Boston Sand & Gravel plant in Charlestown, Massachusetts.
- Today, the former Portsmouth, Great Falls and Conway Railroad infrastructure is owned by the State of New Hampshire, the Conway Scenic Railroad, and New Hampshire Northcoast Corporation.
